notes.title: Achievement Adjustment
notes.content:
Based on player feedback, the Tireless achievement requirement has been updated.
Previously, players had to remain active for 24 hours to earn this achievement.
Now, the requirement has been reduced to 5 hours to make it more accessible while still rewarding dedication.

notes.title: Patch 1.6
notes.content:
Important Fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the doodle incorrectly appeared at level 100.
[*] Corrected the Great Champion and Tireless achievements, ensuring they unlock properly.
[*] Added a New Game confirmation prompt to prevent accidental clicks and loss of progress.
[/list]

notes.title: Bug Fix
notes.content: Bug: Store not deducting money properly.

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.2.0
notes.content:
[list]
[*] [b]Upgrade price balancing:[/b] We've adjusted costs to make upgrades fairer.
[*] [b]AutoMerge system fix:[/b] Resolved an issue that prevented the proper functioning of the auto-merge system.
[*] [b]Reduced skill cooldown times:[/b] All skills now have a cooldown time of just 10 minutes.
[*] [b]Other bug fixes[/b]: Addressed several minor issues to enhance your gaming experience.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes: Vfx Option and Vsync Option
notes.content:
[h1]VFX Toggle Option: [/h1]Added a new option in the settings menu to enable or disable visual effects, allowing players to optimize performance based on their preferences.
[h1]VSync Option:[/h1] Introduced a VSync toggle in the settings menu, giving players the choice to enable or disable VSync for smoother screen performance.
[h1]Bug Fixes:[/h1] Resolved multiple bugs to improve overall game stability and performance.

notes.title: Patch Notes: Balance Adjustments and Bug Fixes
notes.content:
[b]Balance Adjustments:[/b]

[list]
[*] The shop prices now scale correctly with prestige levels.
[*] Upgrade values have been rebalanced to ensure smoother progression.
[/list]


[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed bugs that occurred after reaching the end game.
[*] End game screen translation issues have been resolved.
[*] The "Doodle Explosion" achievement now triggers correctly.
[*] Upgrade progress is now properly saved and restored.
[/list]
[u]This patch improves gameplay balance and addresses critical bugs for a smoother experience!
If you experience any issues with this patch, try using the prestige feature, as it may resolve the problem. If the issue persists, please reach out to our support team, and we'll assist you with any potential bugs.[/u]

notes.title: Reset Button
notes.content: -Reset Your progress, or simply start fresh on a new run.

notes.title: Doodle Harmony Idle Merge
notes.content:
Doodle Harmony Idle Merge is a relaxing idle merging game, where you buy Doodles and generate them in real time, then sell them to turn a profit or keep them around to earn money.

🎨Doodle Merging: Merge two identical Doodles to upgrade them.
💰 Passive Income Generation: Your Doodles earn money for you automatically.
🔄Offline Progress: Keep earning money even when you're not playing.
🔓Unlock New Doodles: Explore a variety of characters to merge and expand your Collection.
🏆Achievements: Unlock achievements as you progress through the game.
📻Radio System: Radio System to choose your music.
🌑Dark Mode: Chose between a light mode and a dark mode.
